def complete_maximum_flow(self, source, sink):
    """Restore maximum cardinality, ignoring costs (used after a deadline)."""
    adj, to, cap = self.adj, self.to, self.cap
    size = self.size
    total = 0
    while True:
        level = [-1]*size; level[source]=0
        queue=[source]; head=0
        while head < len(queue):
            u=queue[head]; head+=1
            for a in adj[u]:
                if cap[a]>0:
                    v=to[a]
                    if level[v]<0:
                        level[v]=level[u]+1; queue.append(v)
        if level[sink]<0: break
        # blocking flow with pointers
        pushed = self._blocking_levels(source, sink, level)
        if pushed <= 0: break
        total += pushed
    return total
